description: This Java source file defines the SSLUtil class, providing utilities for setting up SSL/TLS connections, managing trust managers, key managers, SSL contexts, and verifying hostnames, primarily used for SSL setup and certificate handling within the Ofbiz framework.

classes.name: SSLUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for SSL context creation, trust and key management, hostname verification, and configuration loading for SSL/TLS connections.

classes.name: TrustAnyManager
classes.description: An implementation of X509TrustManager that trusts all certificates, used for bypassing SSL certificate validation.

methods.name: getHostCertNoCheck
methods.description: Returns the constant indicating no host certificate check.

methods.name: getHostCertMinCheck
methods.description: Returns the constant indicating minimum host certificate check.

methods.name: getHostCertNormalCheck
methods.description: Returns the constant indicating normal host certificate check.

methods.name: isClientTrusted
methods.description: Checks whether the provided certificate chain is trusted based on configured trust managers.

methods.name: getKeyManagers
methods.description: Retrieves key managers from keystores, optionally for a specific alias.

methods.name: getTrustManagers
methods.description: Retrieves trust managers based on configured keystores.

methods.name: getTrustAnyManagers
methods.description: Provides trust managers that trust all certificates.

methods.name: getSSLContext
methods.description: Creates and initializes an SSLContext with specified key and trust managers.

methods.name: getSSLSocketFactory
methods.description: Creates an SSLSocketFactory based on keystore and alias configurations.

methods.name: getSSLContext
methods.description: Creates an SSLContext for a specified alias with trust settings.

methods.name: getSSLSocketFactory
methods.description: Creates an SSLSocketFactory for the default or specified alias.

methods.name: getSSLServerSocketFactory
methods.description: Creates an SSLServerSocketFactory based on keystore, password, and alias.

methods.name: getSSLServerSocketFactory
methods.description: Creates an SSLServerSocketFactory for a given alias.

methods.name: getHostnameVerifier
methods.description: Returns a hostname verifier based on specified check level.

methods.name: loadJsseProperties
methods.description: Loads JSSE properties for SSL configuration from property files.

methods.name: loadJsseProperties (overloaded)
methods.description: Loads JSSE properties with optional debug output, initializes system properties for SSL setup.
